channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Congo Ebola death toll surpasses 2,000 in worst outbreak on record
item.description: At least 2,000 deaths have been reported among confirmed cases in Congo's Ebola outbreak, the fastest-spreading on record, according to latest figures.

item.title: Trump asserts U.S. control over Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing standoff
item.description: The standoff between the two nations intensifies as President Trump echoes Iran's compensation demand and asserts U.S. control over the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Zelenskyy reports North Korean missiles used by Russia in Ukraine
item.description: Russia and North Korea have cooperated in the offensive against Ukraine since 2024.

item.title: Trump seeks compensation from Iran as new conditions set for strait reopening
item.description: President Trump indicated he would increase economic pressure on Iran as the standoff continued and Tehran set new conditions for reopening the strait.
